metadata.version_scope_guardrail: The current public response includes both original and amended CAFs. Its site-layout attachment metadata carries the 2025 amendment number, although the original proposal lookup returns it. It is not represented as an immutable 2023 response. The original and amended CAFs reference the same KML UUID; the plan independently names the same legal entity and exact parcels.
metadata.extent_conflict: The field labelled ne_extend numerically matches the polygon southwest extent, and sw_extend matches its northeast extent. Neither label is silently repaired or used to generate geometry; the actual downloaded coordinate ring is selected.
metadata.shape_label_guardrail: The CAF's shape_of_project label is Linear, but the actual active KML contains a Polygon. The observed KML geometry is retained without converting it to a line.

metadata.literal_pointer: KML Document/Placemark/Polygon/outerBoundaryIs/LinearRing/coordinates; document name Project Site.kml, placemark name Untitled Polygon.
metadata.body_format: KML 2.2 XML; response MIME is incorrectly text/html;charset=utf-8.
metadata.source_crs: KML 2.2 LonLat84_5773; WGS 84 longitude then latitude in decimal degrees, with EGM96 orthometric height for altitude.
metadata.coordinate_derivation: Copy longitude/latitude from each source tuple in original ring order; omit all-zero altitude and KML styling. No reprojection, coordinate averaging, extent midpoint or imagery digitization.
metadata.source_numeric_precision: Source ordinates carry 13 or 14 decimal places; exact lexical coordinate tuples are retained. Floating-point parsers may render a last decimal differently; this is not a survey-accuracy estimate.
metadata.source_altitude_scope: Every altitude is zero; altitudeMode is absent and defaults to clampToGround. No elevation, height, terrain or surveyed Z claim is selected.
metadata.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Neither the proponent KML nor the public CAF states a positional-accuracy estimate, survey method, geodetic realization or control points. Decimal count and government hosting do not establish survey accuracy.
metadata.qualification: A proponent-submitted project/campus boundary in a government-hosted statutory filing, used only as a campus locator. It covers the combined data centre, substation and ancillary yard, not a separately counted utility site. Not a cadastral boundary, building footprint, as-built outline, current construction-work extent or imagery observation.
